summary: Daughter of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston and wife of John E. Cook; John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
bio: Caroline H. Scott was born in 1841, probably a daughter of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston; she was nine years old in Stephen Scott's household in 1850. She married John E. Cook (1833–1882), and the couple, who had children from 1861, appear together in the 1870 and 1880 censuses. She died in 1895.

Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable). 9 in 1850.

FamilySearch gives Caroline's married name as Cook, wife of John E. Cook (1833-1882), in the 1870 and 1880 censuses, with children from 1861. It also lists her in Stephen Scott's 1850 household ([R4-S1]).
